top_signals.title: Trump's Russia-Ukraine Energy Ceasefire May Only Cover Oil Refineries
top_signals.summary: President Trump's announcement of an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine appears to be considerably narrower than initially suggested, with a White House official telling Axios that the proposal only covers attacks on oil refineries and with no official confirmation from Moscow as of yet. Trump announced the apparent breakthrough on social media on Sunday, describing it broadly as an energy ceasefire and claiming the agreement was to go into effect immediately.  Effective Immediately: An ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Supertanker Rates Slip From Record Highs
top_signals.summary: Supertanker rates have retreated slightly after touching an all-time high earlier this month, with the price of chartering a very large crude carrier for a trip from the Gulf Coast to China at $634,974 per day, according to Baltic Exchange data cited by Reuters. This compared to a record of over $637,000 per day on October 8, the publication noted. The record price of transporting crude oil from the United States to Asia was undermining demand for U.S. crude.
